## Checklist

- [ ] `poetry test` passes locally (lint + suite)
- [ ] Coverage is still **100%** for statements and branches
- [ ] New code follows the layering: routers handle HTTP, services hold business rules and never import FastAPI
- [ ] New domain exceptions are mapped in `STATUS_BY_ERROR` (`app/main.py`)
- [ ] New models are re-exported in `app/models/__init__.py` and added to `__all__`
- [ ] Model changes come with an Alembic migration, and the autogenerated output was reviewed
- [ ] New environment variables are documented in `README.md` and added to `.env.example`
- [ ] New test directories contain an `__init__.py`
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
